name: Pixelfed
description: Federated photo and video sharing platform built on ActivityPub.

envVars.description: Public domain the instance is served from

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-mariadb"
      DB_DATABASE: pixelfed
      DB_USERNAME: pixelfed
      DB_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
      REDIS_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      APP_KEY: {{env.APP_KEY}}
      APP_DOMAIN: {{env.APP_DOMAIN}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/storage:/var/www/storage
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mariadb
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mariadb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: pixelfed
      MYSQL_USER: pixelfed
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mariadb:/var/lib/mysql
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
